title: ADBC (generic) connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One generic ADBC connector instance's settings: which driver to load out of the namespace's allowlist, where to connect, the projecting SELECT the source runs, and the ingest target and mode the sink bulk-loads into. A driver is native code in the Loams process, so it loads by path from an allowlist with a SHA-256 check (CN1 Ruling 9; CN1 Task 11's driver_outside_allowlist_is_refused and driver_checksum_mismatch_is_refused). `password` and `token` resolve through the namespace's secret store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list.

driver.description: The ADBC driver name; it must be in the namespace's adbc.drivers allowlist (CN1 Ruling 9) and load only from /opt/loams/adbc/<name>/<version>/.

driver_version.description: The pinned driver build to load out of /opt/loams/adbc/<driver>/<version>/.

driver_sha256.description: The expected SHA-256 of the driver shared library; the load is refused on a mismatch (CN1 Ruling 9).

entry_point.description: The ADBC entry point the driver is loaded through, as adbc_driver_manager expects it.

uri.description: The driver's connection URI. Required for every driver except sqlite and duckdb, which address a file.

path.description: The database file, for the sqlite and duckdb drivers.

password.description: The database password, for the drivers that take one. Resolved through the secret store (D189); the rendered driver options read it from a mounted file.

token.description: A bearer or OAuth2 token, for the drivers that take one (Snowflake OAUTH, BigQuery). Resolved through the secret store (D189).

query.description: A projecting SELECT for the source, when the route does not name one.

target_table.description: The sink's bulk-ingest target table (adbc.ingest.target_table, CN1 Task 11).

mode.description: The sink's ingest mode: bulk_ingest append or create_append per Arrow batch, or a staged MERGE where the driver supports it (CN1 Task 11).

merge_key.description: The key a `merge` mode staged MERGE matches on; required when mode is `merge`.

partitions.description: Partitions the source splits the read across: ExecutePartitions where the driver supports it (Snowflake and BigQuery do, verify), else by key ranges (CN1 Task 11).

partition_by.description: The declared key the bulk path partitions by (D356).

batch_rows.description: Rows per Arrow batch (CN1 Ruling 3's default).
